title: Chapter 1498 - 615: Golden Blood Pill Pearl
content:
Chapter 1498: Chapter 615: Golden Blood Pill Pearl

Ye Qingming gently pushed a cup of tea.

The tea soup was clear, but at the bottom, three golden tea leaves were settled. The edges of the leaves were sharp like blades, while the veins were delicate like clouds.

"Golden Bud Enlightenment Tea." She said softly, "One of the Green Tea Society’s Secret Collections! This tea does not increase mana but can clear the mind and boost enlightenment by more than tenfold, preventing you from fainting amid extreme pain and making it easier to touch upon the deeper laws of your innate potential."

Finally, Jin Mantang took out a jade box.

When the jade box was opened, inside was a dull golden-red bead.

Flowing Gold Guest merely took a glance, and his whole body of golden blood couldn’t help but tremble slightly.

He exclaimed in surprise, "Could this be?!"

That bead seemed to be calling out to him.

Jin Mantang put away his smile, adopting a rare serious tone: "This is a Golden Blood Pill Pearl left behind by a predecessor with the Golden Liquid Returning Pill Body upon sitting in meditation. To obtain it, Floating Life Association traversed three hidden lines, spent two hundred thirty thousand spirit stones, and owed two significant favors."

Flowing Gold Guest’s eyes were fixed on the Golden Blood Pill Pearl.

That was a familiar aura.

It was closer to him than the Nine Orifice Blood Gold Embryo, more like his future than any Gold Element Treasure Materials!

The Golden Hairpin Old Woman spoke slowly: "To reach the quasi-divine skills path, treasure materials alone aren’t enough. You also need enlightenment."

Qiu Lei took over the conversation: "Therefore, we have altered a formation for you."

The golden platform in the center of the Cloud Cave shook.

The layers of the Cloud Wall around peeled away, revealing the Great Array hidden behind the clouds. The array patterns weren’t laid flat but suspended in three dimensions, with three hundred sixty golden array nails hanging in all directions and twelve Life Candles standing at the corners. The Life Candles were completely pale, but their wicks were red-gold, and before being lit, an aura of time that chilled the heart emanated from them.

Wen Suzhen whispered, "The array is named Burning Life Ascension Wisdom Array."

Flowing Gold Guest’s face changed: "Burning life?"

Qiu Lei remained expressionless: "To achieve quasi-divine skills, how can there be no price to pay? Once the array activates, it will burn your longevity to elevate your enlightenment. You are still a Golden Core, with a lifespan ahead. Sacrificing thirty years for a quasi-divine skill embryo is a good deal."

Flowing Gold Guest’s eyelids twitched violently.

Thirty years of longevity!

Just as he was about to speak, Lei Wangyue coldly said: "Afraid of Ning Zhuo, afraid of losing longevity, yet wanting quasi-divine skills. Where in the world could such a bargain exist?"

Flowing Gold Guest’s face was extremely unsightly.

Qiu Lei delivered the final blow: "Don’t forget, the contract is signed."

Flowing Gold Guest remained silent for a long while before finally gritting his teeth and stepping into the formation.

He feared death, and he feared Ning Zhuo.

But without quasi-divine skills, his third battle would be a certain defeat. And losing to Ning Zhuo a third time, even if his life were spared again, would likely shatter his path’s heart completely!

"All for the future!" Flowing Gold Guest gritted his teeth.

The formation activated.

The twelve Life Candles lit simultaneously.

No flames shot up, only twelve small red-gold candle lights stood quietly at the formation’s corners.

As the candlelight shone, Flowing Gold Guest groaned, feeling as if thirty years of his lifespan were being carved away by an invisible knife, turning into burning oil, pouring into the Great Array.

Boom!

The Earth Lung Hidden Gold Sand beneath the golden platform suddenly boiled, dark golden sand turned into fine streams, climbing up Flowing Gold Guest’s legs along the array patterns.

Wen Suzhen waved her sleeves, and three hundred sixty-five Life-extending Golden Needles flew out simultaneously, needle light like rain, landing on Flowing Gold Guest’s body apertures. With each needle penetrating, Flowing Gold Guest felt as if a blood aperture was locked by a golden shackle. In the end, his whole body of golden blood had nowhere to vent, only surging crazily within him.

Lei Wangyue flicked his finger, and Purple Gold Thunder Marrow transformed into a stream of Thunder Liquid, pouring into Flowing Gold Guest’s Heavenly Spirit with a roar.

"Ah—" Flowing Gold Guest screamed in agony, his expression extremely grim.

As Thunder Marrow entered the blood, it was like countless Thunder Blades chopping through his blood vessels. The golden blood was scattered, then re-locked by Life-extending Golden Needles; fragmented into mist, then attracted by the Taibai Pill Origin Gold outside the array, re-condensing into dense Pill Patterns.

The Golden Hairpin Old Woman waited a moment, then seeing that the fire control was right, directly threw Taibai Pill Origin Gold into the array.

A pale gold stone suspended in front of Flowing Gold Guest’s chest slowly melted, transforming into circles of platinum light patterns, merging into his flesh and blood.

Under the skin of Flowing Gold Guest’s chest, a small Pill shadow gradually emerged.

This was not the Nine Orifice Blood Gold Embryo, but the first Golden Blood Pill Pearl formed from his own golden blood.

Of course, it had not yet completely formed, only a Void Pill.

Ye Qingming picked up the Golden Bud Enlightenment Tea, the tea soup transforming into a wisp of clear light, falling into Flowing Gold Guest’s brow. His will, almost fainted from pain, suddenly cleared up.

Flowing Gold Guest clenched his teeth, the clarity instead magnifying the pain tenfold!

He clearly felt every drop of golden blood within him, locked, struck by thunder, alchemized, and reshaped.

He could feel the extreme emptiness flowing from his bones as his longevity burned fiercely.

He also sensed the Golden Blood Pill Pearl left by the previous Golden Liquid Returning Pill Body, merging into his body, transforming into an ancient, timeworn, and homogenous golden-red current.

At that moment, Flowing Gold Guest seemed to see another person.

That person was also full of golden blood, likewise unheadably not died, equally endured countless blades and soldiers, yet always stood in a blood bath without falling. Finally, when that person sat in meditation, all their golden blood contracted into a bead, leaving behind an insight close to divine skill.

Blood can be a source.

A source can condense Pills.

Pills can restore the body.

Golden Liquid circulates, endlessly, this is the Returning Pill!

Flowing Gold Guest’s mind and body were tremendously shaken.

He finally saw deep within his innate potential, the hidden path always covered by flesh and blood.

"So the Golden Liquid Returning Pill Body is not just about abundant golden blood, not just about the body turning golden, not just about reconnecting severed heads."

"The true ’Returning Pill’ is the refining of all golden blood into a self-circulating Alchemy Dao."

"Every Golden Blood Pill Pearl is a temporary Golden Core."
